Fraction KC Definitions

This flashcard tutor practices the seven fraction-addition knowledge components used by the SPARC Fractions Addition tutor. Each card shows a definition of a fraction skill. Type the matching KC name with punctuation replaced by spaces.

This deck is intended to be assigned in the same course as SPARC Fractions Addition so the two units can test shared cluster-model behavior through matching clusterKC values.
